location: a rocky depression on the lower hillside overlooking a grey-green valley
canon_summary:
James stepped out of the Great Canopy for the first time, leaving the trees behind to walk onto the open hillside. Sitting on a warm boulder, he quietly watched a thin wisp of smoke rise on the distant horizon.
James left his boulder to journey further down the hillside, testing the open terrain and catching a faint metallic scent on the wind.
James ventured further down the hillside, discovering a strange metallic grey spine half-buried in the earth as the metallic scent grew stronger.
world_lore:
The Great Canopy is the vast, ancient jungle James has lived in his whole life. James's grounding ritual is closing his eyes to count three distinct sounds when nervous, and his habitual formal greeting to any unfamiliar horizon is: 'Pleased to meet you, whatever comes next.'
The lower hillside features buried metallic spines of unknown origin near grey-green flats.
next_beat: By day 5, James should catch his first glimpse of human civilization in the distance -- a rooftop, smoke from a chimney, a distant sound of machinery -- something that hints a wider world exists beyond the jungle, without him reaching it yet.
